NewsArticle.Title: A Troublemaker or a Godsend?
NewsArticle.Content:
The Kelberoth, a mighty animal from mythology, has been summoned into the realm of Temuair. This creature is extremely dangerous and, unlike other creatures of the land, roams the territories freely. It appears infrequently in random locations, jumping into this plane of existence to terrorize and feed.
The powers of the Light and Chaos war have decided to make this the latest contest for their battle. Giving the Aislings just over a Temuair week ((Ends Wednesday, 09/05/01)) the Disciples of both powers must become Stalkers, searching for this beast. All Aislings can assist in locating the beasts as they appear.
The Stalkers must be the ones who kill the creature and gain the validation of the kill. Afterwards, the Stalker should not hunt any other creatures besides the Kelberoth. It will only be the fresh kill - the most recent kill of the Stalker that will be counted in the end. To the side who's Disciples and/or Champion that kills the most Kelberoths will receive the win for their side.
